newsitem.title: GREECE: Ecu/drachma eases, depos hold, forwards slip.
newsitem.headline: Ecu/drachma eases, depos hold, forwards slip.

text.p: Ecu/drachma was trading near its intraday low of 308.20/30 in late dealings after hitting a high of 308.70 at open, depos were little changed and forex forwards were softer in periods up to three months, dealers said.
Bond dealers said concerns about the course of implied drachma rates drove prices of FRN due January 28, 2004 about 15 basis points lower but fixed coupon bonds were steady.
"Depos were flat and forex forwards were trading lower in tenors up to three months after a private bank came out lending drachmas earlier on," a foreign bank dealer said.
The mark was quoted at 158.42/52 from Thursday's 158.560 fix, the dollar at 264.38/48 drachmas from 264.940 and the ecu at 308.34/44 from 308.500 drachmas.
